entries.69ffceffda8f92ba: The business provides contact center and BPO services that take on, on a one-stop basis, everything from planning and designing to training and operating client companies' operations, and develops and sells AI and DX solutions using digital technologies such as the in-house cloud PBX “Omnia LINK.” For the fiscal year ended May 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥36,322 million, and the filing's major-customer information prints ¥5,131 million for TEPCO Energy Partner, Inc. and ¥1,706 million for Pasona Inc. Through Radiant Communication Sdn. Bhd., a Malaysian company that became a subsidiary in the fiscal year ended May 2026, the company also provides AI and DX solutions overseas.

entries.9c96bdb91eb7552d: The company is headquartered in Shinjuku-ku, Tokyo, and the group consists of the company and five consolidated subsidiaries, six companies in total. The reportable segment is a single segment, the Contact Center and BPO Business, and the number of consolidated employees for the fiscal year ended May 2026 was 793.
